added.member: UI documents: mounted screens are layers
added.summary: A `type screen` document mounted with scope.mount is a layer of the stack while it is mounted: its data-layer, data-pause, data-back and data-focus apply, its bindings read the mount's stores, Back or a pop trigger unmounts it, and snapshots carry it. Its root's path is `scope:id/<root id>`.
The store-driven mount that shows a layer, `scope:id`; empty for a pushed screen.

CSS View Transitions for a screen's layer: @view-transition { navigation: auto } cross-fades the layer as it joins and leaves the stack (the UA's fade-in and fade-out); ::view-transition-new(root) and ::view-transition-old(root) take animation with the document's @keyframes, ::view-transition-group(root) and -image-pair(root) their inherited timing, and types gate :active-view-transition-type() rules. The engine's covers are built-in keyframes -og-iris, -og-dissolve, -og-wipe and -og-slide (-from-right/top/bottom); ::view-transition background-color is their colour.
